title: Scrum Master (Full-Time / Part-Time)
description:
**About GoSuper EdTech**
At GoSuper EdTech, we are a team of passionate innovators dedicated to reshaping the education sector through cutting-edge technology.
  
  
Our mission is to make high-quality education accessible, efficient, and impactful for everyone. With a global footprint and a deep understanding of local needs, we bridge traditional education with modern, AI-driven solutions.
  
  
We're building a new kind of learning platform — where community, AI, and SaaS intersect to create scalable, personalized experiences for millions of learners.
  
  
If you're driven by high-impact challenges, product ownership, and meaningful work, GoSuper offers a front-row seat to the future of education technology.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a Scrum Master with 6 months to 1 year of experience who can support our product, engineering, design, QA, and business teams in planning, tracking, and delivering work efficiently.
  
  
This role is open for both full-time and part-time candidates. The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of Agile and Scrum practices, strong coordination skills, and the ability to keep teams organized and aligned.
  
  
At GoSuper EdTech, we use Zoho products for project management, sprint tracking, task management, bug tracking, documentation, and team collaboration, similar to how other companies use Jira. The Scrum Master will be expected to work with tools such as Zoho Sprints, Zoho Projects, Zoho BugTracker, Zoho Cliq, Zoho WorkDrive, Zoho Sheet, and related Zoho products.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who is organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and interested in building a career in Agile project management, product coordination, and SaaS product delivery.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Facilitate daily standups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and team coordination meetings.
* Support product and engineering teams in planning, organizing, and tracking sprint activities.
* Create, update, assign, and monitor tasks using Zoho project management tools.
* Maintain sprint boards, task lists, milestones, timelines, bug trackers, and project dashboards in Zoho.
* Track feature progress, bugs, blockers, dependencies, pending tasks, and delivery risks.
* Coordinate with product managers, developers, designers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to ensure clarity on tasks and priorities.
* Help teams follow Agile and Scrum practices in a practical, startup-friendly way.
* Assist in backlog grooming, sprint preparation, task prioritization, and release coordination.
* Prepare meeting notes, sprint updates, progress summaries, action-item trackers, and weekly reports.
* Follow up with team members to ensure tasks are updated and deadlines are visible.
* Identify delays, blockers, and risks, and escalate them to the right stakeholders when required.
* Support documentation using Zoho WorkDrive, Zoho Writer, Zoho Sheet, or similar tools.
* Help maintain transparency across teams by keeping project information updated and organized.
* Contribute to improving internal workflows, sprint discipline, reporting habits, and team communication.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 6 months to 1 year of experience as a Scrum Master, Project Coordinator, Agile Coordinator, Product Coordinator, Business Analyst, or similar role.
* Basic understanding of Agile, Scrum, sprint planning, and software development workflows.
* Familiarity with Scrum ceremonies such as daily standups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Hands-on experience or willingness to work with Zoho products for task tracking and project management.
* Ability to use tools similar to Jira, especially Zoho Sprints, Zoho Projects, Zoho BugTracker, or related platforms.
* Good understanding of task status, priority, ownership, deadlines, blockers, bugs, and dependencies.
* Strong communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work with developers, designers, QA, product managers, and business stakeholders.
* Good documentation and meeting management skills.
* Basic understanding of the software development life cycle.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to keep project information organized.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, meetings, and timelines.
* Problem-solving mindset and willingness to take ownership of project coordination.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.

Full-Time Responsibilities
  
  

* For full-time candidates, the role will involve deeper ownership of sprint operations, daily team coordination, project tracking, reporting, and cross-functional delivery support.
* Full-time Scrum Masters will be expected to work closely with teams throughout the day, maintain project dashboards, follow up on blockers, coordinate releases, and support multiple product or engineering workflows.

Part-Time Responsibilities
  
  

* For part-time candidates, the role will focus on structured sprint support, task tracking, meeting coordination, blocker follow-ups, reporting, and documentation.
* Part-time Scrum Masters should be available for key meetings such as daily standups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and important coordination calls. The role requires disciplined follow-up and timely updates even within limited working hours.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Scrum Master certification or Agile training.
* Experience using Zoho Sprints, Zoho Projects, Zoho BugTracker, Zoho Cliq, Zoho WorkDrive, Zoho Sheet, or Zoho Analytics.
* Experience working with software development, SaaS, EdTech, or AI-based product teams.
* Basic understanding of UI/UX, QA testing, development cycles, bug tracking, and release workflows.
* Experience preparing sprint reports, project dashboards, weekly updates, or milestone reports.
* Familiarity with tools such as GitHub Projects, Notion, Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp, Trello, Asana, or similar platforms.
* Prior internship, freelance, or academic project experience in Agile project management or product coordination.
* Experience supporting remote or hybrid teams.
* Interest in product management, technology operations, startup execution, and SaaS delivery.

What You’ll Gain
  
  

* Hands-on experience managing real SaaS and EdTech product workflows in a startup environment.
* Practical exposure to Agile, Scrum, sprint planning, backlog management, and release coordination.
* Experience working with Zoho-based project management systems similar to Jira.
* Mentorship from product, engineering, and business leaders.
* Opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams and understand complete product development cycles.
* Learning opportunities in SaaS, AI, EdTech, project management, and product operations.
* Exposure to real business problems, live users, and high-impact product delivery.
* A feedback-driven environment that encourages ownership, learning, and continuous improvement.
* Access to Cult Elite and Cult Play Pass, offering wellness and lifestyle benefits to keep you energized and inspired.

**Compensation**

* Competitive compensation based on role type, availability, experience, skillset, and contribution.
* For full-time candidates, the package may include fixed compensation, performance-based bonuses, and equity participation through ESOPs.
* For part-time candidates, compensation will be structured based on working hours, responsibilities, and project involvement.

**Benefits**

* Flexible remote work options with occasional Bengaluru office meetups.
* Opportunity to work with product, engineering, design, QA, and business teams.
* Hands-on exposure to Zoho-based project management workflows.
* Learning and development support to help you grow in Agile, Scrum, product coordination, and project management.
* Health and wellness perks, including Cult Elite membership and Cult Play Pass, based on eligibility.
* Fast, feedback-driven culture with mentorship from experienced leaders.
* Opportunity to contribute to the future of education technology.

Life at GoSuper EdTech
  
  
At GoSuper, engineers are creators. We value curiosity, ownership, and fast iteration. You’ll work on meaningful problems and build tools that touch the lives of real users every day.
  
  
We're building with purpose - and we're looking for like-minded people who want to build with us.
  
  
Apply via mail
  
  
Send your application through mail to with your resume and a short note. Mention the specific role in the subject line.
  
  
Mention “Scrum Master (Full-Time / Part-Time)” in the subject line.
  
  
Need Assistance?
  
  
Contact our HR team at +91 91117 47111 for any queries.

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. **Manager, Product Analyst**
The Product Analyst serves as a key liaison between business stakeholders, Product Managers, architects, engineers, and delivery teams to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions. This role combines product analysis, business process optimization, requirements management, and solution delivery support to help ensure products deliver measurable business value and a strong user experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with business stakeholders and product teams to gather, analyze, and document business and system requirements.
* Define the business problem, translate business needs into user stories, success metrics, acceptance criteria, workflows, and functional specifications
* Apply in-depth knowledge and analysis of current- and future-state processes to inform and shape sound technology solutions
* Understands end-to-end workflows and identifies opportunities for simplification, automation and optimization
* Support product roadmap planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, and release activities.
* Collaborate with engineering and architecture teams to ensure solutions meet business requirements and enterprise standards
* Lead process analysis, testing, user acceptance activities, and implementation readiness efforts.
* Monitor product performance, user feedback, and business outcomes to identify continuous improvement opportunities.
* Build strong partnerships with global business, IT, and vendor teams and act as the voice of the customer.

**Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience with a BS/BA or 4+ years with an MS/MA/MBA in Product Analysis, Business Analysis, Systems Analysis, Product Management, or related technology roles.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements and translating them into technology solutions.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, SDLC, business process analysis, and product delivery practices.
* Proven track record successfully working with cross-functional stakeholders, development teams, and global delivery organizations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar collaboration platforms.
* Prior experience working in a global GCC or similar, geographically-distributed matrixed organizations.
* Experience in Life Sciences, Healthcare, or other regulated industries is preferred.

title: Tech Manager I [T500-30030]
description:
**About lululemon:**

Founded in 1998 at Vancouver, lululemon is a performance and lifestyle product company that create transformational products and experiences that build meaningful connections, unlocking greater possibility and wellbeing for all. We are driven by our brand purpose to elevate human potential by making individuals feel their best which helps us design our products with high filter and high style. We use a unique product creation methodology called Science of Feel in all our products to offer convenient, comfortable, and long-lasting experience. We owe our success to our innovative products, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in.

We are excited to announce an opening for Tech Manager I at Lululemon.

Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities.

**Skills Required:**

* Java, Microservices, AWS, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Rest, Rest API.

**Experience Range:**

* 12 - 15 years.

**Key qualifications and candidate profile:**

**Leadership Approach and Technical Roadmap:**

* You are an independent leader who excels at guiding and managing team members with diverse skill sets. Clear communication of expectations is a central aspect of your leadership style, ensuring every team member is aligned and understands their responsibilities.

**Technical Roadmap and Initiative Delivery:**

* Beyond strong management skills, your role as a leader encompasses ownership of the technical roadmap for your team. You consistently communicate timeline, scope, and risks to partners and stakeholders, and you lead the delivery of major initiatives according to clearly defined timelines.

**Strategic Technical Debt Management:**

* You proactively identify areas of strategic technical debt, conduct cost/benefit analyses to determine the impact of addressing these issues, and communicate recommended prioritization timelines to the management team.

**Continuous Improvement and Team Support:**

* The team is committed to adopting leading-edge technologies and continuously improving solutions. There is a strong emphasis on mutual support, fostering an environment where team members help each other grow both professionally and personally.
* The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of delivering results by successfully leading large, cross-functional teams in executing complex solutions within matrixed organizations. This individual thrives in fast-paced environments and demonstrates the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage complexity effectively. They are adept at creating and streamlining processes, ensuring operational efficiency while simultaneously supporting team members across a rapidly expanding global organization.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills are essential in this role, as is the capacity to identify and address bottlenecks, manage escalation processes, and anticipate potential challenges. The candidate must be able to make informed tradeoffs and balance competing business needs with technical constraints. Success in this position requires maturity, a strong sense of curiosity, creative problem-solving abilities, and effective team leadership.

**A DAY IN THE LIFE:**

* As a Technical Manager, you are responsible for leading a multifaceted team comprising project leads, analysts, engineers, testers, business stakeholders, and software vendors. This leadership spans across several concurrent work streams, requiring careful coordination and management to ensure successful outcomes.
* You oversee the end-to-end process, managing people and project timelines to consistently produce high-quality deliverables. Your focus on effective process management ensures that every aspect of the project progresses smoothly and meets the established standards.
* Demonstrating thought leadership, you mentor engineers to adopt best practices in technology, architecture, and design. Your guidance helps the team leverage innovative approaches and maintain a high standard of technical excellence.
* The Technical Manager plays an integral role in strategic planning, project execution, and the ongoing development of technology talent. You are committed to recruiting, hiring, mentoring, and coaching technical staff to build a robust and skilled team.
* You curate strong, collaborative relationships with stakeholders, business partners, and technology teams. By driving alignment through effective partnerships, you ensure that everyone is working toward common goals and objectives.
* Your leadership ensures that the team produces software meeting both business and technology requirements. You make certain that the right skills are applied to solve the right problems, maintaining a focus on effective and efficient solutions.
* You champion and enforce software development and operational support processes, promoting consistency and reliability across all work streams.
* The success and development of your team are your top priorities. You actively identify and remove roadblocks to ensure your team can excel and deliver outstanding results.
* As a leader, you champion Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Action (IDEA) in everyday life, fostering a supportive and equitable environment for all team members.

**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Educational Background: Candidates should possess a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or have equivalent professional experience.
* Professional Experience: A minimum of 12 years in the IT or engineering sector is required, including at least 4 years of experience in a people management role. This demonstrates a proven ability to lead and guide teams within technical environments.
* Technical Expertise: Applicants must have over 5 years of strong, hands-on experience in designing and architecting systems using Java Microservices frameworks. They should also have expertise in integration technologies such as Kafka or MQ, as well as data architecture and cloud services, particularly AWS or similar platforms.
* Experience working on backend services (REST API, Microservices)
* Database Proficiency: Strong experience working with relational database management systems, specifically Oracle or PostgreSQL.
* Agile and Tools Experience: Experience with Agile methodologies is highly valued. Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools, such as Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint, is also important.
* DevOps and Test Automation: Candidates should have hands-on experience working with and leading teams in DevOps, along with a solid understanding of test automation practices.
* Industry Knowledge: Industry experience within the retail domain is preferred, especially knowledge related to supply chain operations and warehouse management systems.
* Team Leadership: Proven experience in leading, coaching, and mentoring teams comprising architects, business analysts, and engineers focused on project delivery and support.
* Management and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong team management capabilities, excellent analytical skills, and a demonstrated ability to solve complex problems are essential.
* Business and Technology Alignment: The role requires experience in making critical trade-offs between business requirements and technology constraints to achieve optimal outcomes.
* Technological Awareness: A strong understanding of current technological trends is needed, with the ability to leverage this knowledge to deliver innovative solutions that enhance the organization’s competitive advantage.
* Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Effective communication and interpersonal abilities, along with a high level of professionalism, are necessary for successful collaboration across all organizational levels.
* Change Leadership: The ideal candidate should be comfortable challenging the status quo, championing change, and influencing others to embrace new approaches.
* Interpersonal and Leadership Abilities: Strong skills in collaboration, facilitation, and negotiation are required to lead teams and drive successful project outcomes.

**MUST HAVES:**

* Acknowledges the presence of choice in every moment and takes personal responsibility for their life.
* Possesses an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovates to achieve great results.
* Communicates with honesty and kindness and creates the space for others to do the same.
* Leads with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.
* Fosters connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.
* Integrates fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take themselves too seriously.

title: Software Development Manager
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
  
  
This Position reports to:
  
  
Lead Technology Product Manager
  
  
  
  
  
  
**What We Believe In**
ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.
  
  
We offer a broad range of automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control and software as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.
  
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
In this role, we are looking for an experienced
**Software Development Manager**
to join our Industrial Automation Digital Organization. You will lead a high-performing engineering team responsible for building enterprise-grade Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) software used by global industrial customers.
  
  
The role requires strong technical leadership combined with people management and delivery ownership. You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Architects, Principal Engineers, Quality Engineering and DevOps teams to deliver secure, scalable, cloud-native software solutions while driving engineering excellence and continuous innovation.
  
  
The work model for the role is: Hybrid
  
  
**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Leading, mentoring and growing a team of software engineers while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration and engineering excellence.
* Remaining technically hands-on through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping and selective software development activities.
* Driving delivery of cloud-native enterprise software using technologies such as .NET/C#, React, TypeScript, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, SQL Server, REST APIs and microservices.
* Partnering with Product Management and Architecture teams to translate product vision into scalable, high-quality software solutions.
* Establishing engineering best practices covering software architecture, coding standards, testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability and operational excellence.
* Ensuring secure software development through secure coding practices, vulnerability management, dependency scanning and deployment governance.
* Driving engineering productivity by promoting AI-assisted development tools, automation, modern engineering practices and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Managing sprint planning, release planning, delivery tracking, risk management and engineering KPIs to ensure predictable and high-quality software releases.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams including Quality Engineering, DevOps, Security and Product Management to deliver customer-focused solutions.
* Coaching engineers on technical growth, career development, full-stack engineering capabilities and cloud-native software development.

**Qualifications For The Role**

* 12–15 years of professional software engineering experience with strong hands-on development expertise.
* Minimum 5 years of experience managing or leading software engineering teams.
* Strong experience developing enterprise software using modern backend technologies such as .NET/C#, Java or equivalent, with exposure to React and TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience building cloud-native applications using Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, microservices and distributed systems.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, API design, event-driven systems, scalability, reliability and modern engineering practices.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps, automated testing and software release management.
* Knowledge of secure software engineering practices including secure coding, authentication, authorization and vulnerability management.
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Preferred experience in Industrial Automation, Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM), MES, SCADA, Industrial IoT or similar enterprise platforms.
* Exposure to technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, time-series data, AI-enabled engineering practices and Agile/SAFe methodologies will be an advantage.

**More About Us**
ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. The Process Automation (PA) business area automates, electrifies and digitalizes some of the world's most complex industrial infrastructures across energy, process, hybrid and maritime industries.
  
  
Working with ABB provides opportunities to solve meaningful industrial challenges, leverage modern cloud-native technologies and AI-assisted engineering practices, and build innovative software solutions that help customers operate safer, smarter and more sustainable industries
  
  
Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
  
  
Recruitment Fraud Warning
  
  
ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.
  
  
View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home
  
  
For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Manager, Software Engineering – Managed Threat Response**
Bengaluru, India
  
  
**About Mimecast**
Mimecast is a leading cybersecurity company that helps organizations protect their people, data, and communications. With over 42,000 customers worldwide, Mimecast has a long history of excellence in Data Archiving and eDiscovery and is recognised as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Digital Communications Governance and Archiving Solutions.
  
  
We are pioneers in Human Risk Management, recognizing that people are both an organization's greatest asset and its most significant security vulnerability. Our platform addresses the human element of cybersecurity through advanced threat detection, awareness training, Incydr risk management, and data governance. Our Governance, Compliance & Insight products play a critical role in this mission, ensuring that communications data is archived, discoverable, and compliant, enabling organizations to manage the risk that stems from human actions.
  
  
**AI-First Engineering at Mimecast**
Mimecast is an AI-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations. We're looking for leaders who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working.
  
  
Our AI leadership extends beyond how we build to what we build. Our Mihra AI agent delivers 7x faster threat response for customers, and we're recognized as "Agents of Change" in Human Risk Management. Engineers here work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI tooling and AI-powered security products that protect organizations worldwide.
  
  
**The driving force behind Collaboration Security at Mimecast**
Dive into the forefront of innovation with our Managed Threat Response engineering team, where we build the platforms that detect, investigate, and remediate threats on behalf of our customers. Our products leverage the latest technologies and advances in Artificial Intelligence to stay one step ahead of cybercriminals — and we build them the same way.
  
  
**Why Join Our Team?**
*“This is a build role. You will be standing up a new engineering squad in Bengaluru for products our customers depend on every day, in a team where AI is how the work gets done rather than a side experiment. If you are already the person your team turns to — for the technical calls and for the advice — and you want to make that your actual job, this is the step.”*
– Hiring Manager
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As a Manager, Software Engineering you will build and lead a squad covering Mailroom and Threat Portal, with contributions into our Managed Email Incident Response and Remediation products. This is a genuine build: you will hire the team, onboard it, and get it delivering reliably. Your responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Hire, onboard, and retain a new engineering squad, working closely with Recruitment and HR in a highly competitive market.
* Own team-level delivery — commitments, technical debt, on-call load, and stakeholder expectations — holding all of them at once without letting any one collapse.
* Run genuinely developmental 1:1s, set clear expectations, and give honest feedback early rather than late, including the difficult kind.
* Create the conditions for engineers to do their best technical work: enough structure that people know what is expected, enough autonomy that they own their technical decisions.
* Make AI-first engineering a team capability rather than an individual habit — support engineers in building their own agentic development workflows, and hold the quality bar on what those tools produce.
* Know when to coach an engineer through a technical decision and when to make the call yourself, and resolve technical disagreements within the team constructively.
* Partner with Product, Support, and peer engineering teams, representing your team's technical position and delivery risk honestly to senior stakeholders.
* Identify and mitigate technical and delivery risk early, and monitor cloud resource usage for cost savings that do not compromise performance or reliability.

**What You'll Bring**
This may be your first formal management role. What matters is that you have already been doing much of the job informally, and that you want to develop engineers more than you want to ship the feature yourself.
  
  

* An engineering background you can still use. Hands-on experience building and running backend services at scale, deep enough that you remain credible in design and code review and can ask the right questions even when you are not the one making the call.
* Evidence that you already develop people. Time as a technical lead, mentor, or onboarding owner — a track record of engineers who got better because of you, and of feedback you gave that was uncomfortable to deliver and useful to receive.
* Proven AI-first engineering practice, and a view on what it means for a team. You have personally built this way with agentic coding tools, and you have a clear position on what AI-mature engineering practice should look like across a squad. We work in Cursor, but we care that you have built this way, not which tool you used.
* Critical judgement over AI output, applied as a standard. A working understanding of where these tools fail — hallucinated APIs, plausible-but-wrong logic, silent security and performance regressions — and the willingness to hold a team to a quality bar rather than celebrate raw throughput.
* Delivery ownership across a team. Planning, execution, and predictable delivery of complex work; comfort with the trade-off between delivery speed and engineering quality, and the ability to explain the call you made to both engineers and executives.
* Hiring and team building. Experience attracting, assessing, and onboarding engineering talent, or clear evidence you have been central to it.
* Strong communication across distance. You explain technical concepts credibly to technical and non-technical audiences, and you work effectively with colleagues distributed across multiple time zones.
* A real appetite for the shift from doing to developing. The instinct to solve problems directly comes from genuine competence; the defining challenge of this role is redirecting that energy into the people around you.
* Nice to have: prior work in cybersecurity or email security; experience managing on-call rotations and incident response; and experience leading distributed or newly formed teams.

**What We Bring**
Join our Managed Threat Response team to accelerate your career journey, leading a team whose work has direct and visible customer impact. You will not be doing this alone: you will have the support of senior engineering leadership, a global network of peer engineering managers, and deliberate investment in your development as a leader — this is a role we expect you to grow into and beyond.
  
  
You and your team will be given first-class AI development tooling and the mandate to get genuinely good with it. We treat AI engineering capability as a skill we invest in and measure, and we judge teams on the outcomes they ship and the quality they sustain — not on lines of code written.
  
  
Mimecast offers formal and on-the-job learning opportunities and maintains a comprehensive benefits package that helps our employees and their family members sustain a healthy lifestyle. We believe in 'growth that's good', we have 'a culture that cares' and we are on a 'mission that matters'.
  
  
**Our Hybrid Model:**
We provide you with the flexibility to live balanced, healthy lives through our hybrid working model that champions both collaborative teamwork and individual flexibility. Employees are expected to come to the office at least two days per week, because working together in person:
  
  

* Fosters a culture of collaboration, communication, performance and learning
* Drives innovation and creativity within and between teams
* Introduces employees to priorities outside of their immediate realm
* Ensures important interpersonal relationships and connections with one another and our community!

**Belonging at Mimecast**
Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.
  
  
We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.
  
  
We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.
  
  
*Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.*
*It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.*

title: Lead Software Development Engineer
description:
**How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)**
As a Lead Development Engineer, you will join a team of highly adaptable engineers responsible for rapidly learning new business domains, understanding complex technology ecosystems, and delivering high-priority business outcomes. Engineers in this organization are expected to engage across multiple domains, become productive quickly, execute prioritized initiatives, and transition seamlessly to new opportunities as business priorities evolve.
  
  
Success in this role requires strong technical depth, systems thinking, business curiosity, and the ability to navigate complex enterprise environments with numerous upstream and downstream dependencies. Candidates must be comfortable working across modern cloud-native platforms, enterprise integrations, legacy systems, APIs, and emerging AI-enabled solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-based applications using AWS services.
* Develop and maintain APIs, microservices, and integration services that enable critical business capabilities.
* Establish trusted partnerships with domain engineering teams and deliver solutions that align with existing engineering standards, delivery processes, and operational models.
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code and contribute to both front-end and back-end development as a full-stack engineer.
* Apply AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and improve code quality.
* Apply cloud engineering best practices, including security, observability, and cost optimization.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery.
* Develop and deploy containerized applications using Kubernetes and OpenShift.
* Leverage Infrastructure-as-Code and automation practices.
* Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability capabilities.
* Contribute to experimentation and adoption of Generative and Agentic AI capabilities and intelligent automation solutions.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
* Stay up to date with the latest AWS technologies and industry trends.

**What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7-12 years of experience in software development with Java 11+/J2EE in Spring boot, with a focus on cloud technologies.
* Proficiency in AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and services such as Amazon SageMaker, Bedrock, and Agent Core.
* Experience building scalable cloud-native, distributed, and event-driven applications.
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture and API design.
* Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Kiro) to accomplish tasks such as generating and reviewing code, writing and maintaining tests, creating documentation, and debugging, with the judgment to validate and own AI-generated output.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, AI workflows, or model integration patterns.
* Experience working with generative AI or LLM-based solutions is highly desirable.
* Rapidly learn new business domains, alliance partner ecosystems, and integrated travel experiences to support evolving business priorities.
* Analyze system dependencies, data flows, APIs, and integration patterns to identify risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities that accelerate delivery.
* Collaborate across application, architecture, and business teams to drive cross-functional solutions, ensure operational readiness, and maintain delivery momentum across initiatives.
* Lead technical design sessions and architecture discussions.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Lead initiatives with high accountability, create a collaborative environment with a solution-based approach.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and mentor for the team offering technical advice.
* Ability to communicate with precision, engaging team and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships across cross-functional teams and geographies enabling organizational alignment.
* Ability to set priorities with the team by understanding interdependence, inspiring team members with consistent focus, quality output, and timelines.
* Constantly keep oneself updated on current technology & trends to drive innovative decisions through piloting forward-thinking approaches to complex problems in one’s own area of work.
* Inquisitive to understand customer priorities and business challenges while creating value for technical solutions.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or Node.js.
* Strong hands-on experience in observability via tools like DynaTrace, Datadog, etc.
* Experience working in an airline technology environment is preferred.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer certification.
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting AI models to external tools and data sources.
* Ability to quickly develop expertise in new business domains, customer journeys, interconnected enterprise systems, and partner ecosystems to drive rapid delivery of business priorities.
* Proven analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across technical and business teams.
* Experience operating within large-scale enterprise environments, including cloud transformation and legacy modernization initiatives.
* Delivers complex engineering solutions from design through implementation with minimal oversight.
* Leverage systems thinking to navigate dependencies, solve complex business and technology challenges, and deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions.

**About The Company**
What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service.
  
  
Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.
  
  
In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor’s 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience.
  
  
**About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore**
The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.deltatechhub.com
  
  
Why join?
  
  

* Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience.
* Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs –exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that drive engineering excellence and customer outcomes.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**Why Chubb?**

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company! Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.

* Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence

The role will:

  

  
* Coordinate the transition from the current operating model toward the target Command Center/NOC model.
  
  
* Manage delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks and readiness activities for implementation.
  
  
* Coordinate onboarding of services and applications into the agreed NOC operating model.
  
  
* Help establish clear operational handoffs between the NOC, Observability Engineering, SRE, platform teams, product/application teams and incident-management functions.
  
  
* Coordinate delivery of runbooks, escalation paths, operational procedures and supporting documentation required for onboarding.
  
  
* Track readiness and dependencies across monitoring, event management and ITSM integrations.
  
  
* Coordinate the resolution of delivery gaps between Pearson teams and strategic service partners.
  
  
* Ensure issues requiring engineering intervention are routed to the appropriate technical teams through clearly defined escalation pathways.
  

  

Pearson's current Command Center Model describes the target model as
**Observe Triage Act Escalate**
, incorporating monitoring, prioritization and enrichment, runbook-based L1 actions, incident creation/routing and escalation to appropriate technical or incident-management functions.

  
  

We position the NOC as the first line for proactive monitoring alerts, initially supporting Platform Engineering applications and potentially expanding later.

  
  

**3. Program & Technology Delivery**

  
  

Independently own complex delivery across multiple interconnected workstreams.

  

  
* Develop and maintain integrated delivery plans.
  
  
* Define milestones, dependencies and critical-path activities.
  
  
* Drive activities through to completion without requiring close supervision.
  
  
* Proactively identify risks and emerging delivery problems.
  
  
* Diagnose root causes and bring options and recommendations rather than simply escalating issues.
  
  
* Manage scope and priority changes.
  
  
* Ensure delivery commitments and decisions are documented.
  
  
* Maintain RAID logs, delivery dashboards and appropriate governance artifacts.
  
  
* Facilitate sprint and delivery planning where applicable.
  
  
* Ensure dependencies between engineering teams, operational teams and external partners remain visible and actively managed.
  

  

This is particularly relevant to your intended model because you have already identified sprint planning and ongoing Observability/NOC delivery as responsibilities appropriate for the TDM.

  
  

**4. Application & Service Onboarding**

  
  

Establish a predictable delivery process for onboarding services into Observability Engineering and the Command Center/NOC.

  

  
* Coordinate onboarding requirements with application, infrastructure and SRE teams.
  
  
* Ensure appropriate monitoring and operational-readiness prerequisites are identified.
  
  
* Track onboarding progress, blockers and outstanding dependencies.
  
  
* Coordinate the operational handover into BAU processes.
  
  
* Ensure onboarding materials, ownership and escalation paths are available.
  
  
* Identify opportunities to standardize and automate repeatable onboarding activities.
  
  
* Work with engineering teams to reduce manual coordination and improve onboarding scalability.
  

  

Pearson's documented Observability BAU scope already includes New Relic/Grafana access and administration, wallboard onboarding, data-source connectivity validation, synthetic checks, dashboard verification, platform health checks, initial incident triage and standard platform onboarding requests.

  
  

**5. Delivery Governance, Metrics & Reporting**

  
  

Create strong visibility of delivery health and progress across Observability Engineering and NOC initiatives.

  

  
* Establish appropriate delivery governance.
  
  
* Maintain roadmap status and delivery reporting.
  
  
* Track risks, dependencies, decisions, issues and actions.
  
  
* Provide concise reporting to Platform Engineering and technology leadership.
  
  
* Use delivery data to identify bottlenecks and drive improvements.
  
  
* Coordinate delivery health reviews and stakeholder checkpoints.
  
  
* Ensure roadmap and delivery records remain current.
  
  
* Capture lessons learned and incorporate improvements into future delivery.
  

  

Delivery metrics and dashboards have already been identified as an important consideration in Pearson's broader Platform Engineering operating-model discussions.

  
  

The Observability and NOC initiatives are also being incorporated into the longer-term technology roadmap.

  
  

**6. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership**

  
  

Act as a central delivery coordination point across the technology organization.

  
  

Build strong working relationships across:

  

  
* Observability Engineering
  
  
* SRE
  
  
* Platform Engineering
  
  
* Cloud Engineering
  
  
* Application and Product Engineering
  
  
* Service Management
  
  
* Incident Management
  
  
* Security
  
  
* Technology leadership
  
  
* Strategic technology/service partners
  

  

The role will translate strategy and technical objectives into coordinated delivery activities and ensure stakeholders understand status, dependencies, decisions and risks.

  
  

The position should be capable of facilitating difficult cross-team conversations and resolving coordination gaps without needing formal organizational authority.

  
  

**7. Vendor & Partner Delivery Coordination**

  
  

Coordinate delivery activities involving strategic partners supporting the Command Center/NOC and Observability operating model.

  

  
* Translate Pearson requirements into clear delivery expectations.
  
  
* Track partner commitments, dependencies and deliverables.
  
  
* Coordinate scope clarification and operational-readiness activities.
  
  
* Validate delivery dependencies with internal technical teams.
  
  
* Facilitate delivery reviews and issue-resolution discussions.
  
  
* Escalate material delivery risks with options and recommendations.
  
  
* Ensure internal and external teams have aligned expectations around responsibilities and handoffs.
  

  

This is highly relevant to the current role because Pearson has been working through Command Center scope, sizing, workload inputs, operating-model boundaries and commercial considerations with its external partner.

  
  

**8. Operational Readiness & Service Transition**

  
  

Ensure new capabilities move cleanly from project delivery into sustainable operations.

  

  
* Define and track operational-readiness requirements.
  
  
* Coordinate readiness reviews before services enter BAU support.
  
  
* Ensure operational ownership and support routes are established.
  
  
* Ensure escalation paths and handoffs between NOC, SRE, engineering and support teams are understood.
  
  
* Coordinate runbook and operational-documentation readiness.
  
  
* Identify operational gaps and drive corrective actions before onboarding.
  
  
* Capture lessons from operational issues and feed them back into delivery improvement.
  

  

The current Observability BAU model includes platform health validation, synthetic validation, initial incident triage, alert acknowledgment, basic root-cause identification, log collection, documentation and escalation to appropriate teams.

  
  

**Expectations**

  
  

The Technology Delivery Manager is expected to demonstrate:

  
  

**Autonomous Ownership**

  
  

Take end-to-end ownership of complex delivery areas with minimal supervision.

  
  

**Complexity Management**

  
  

Manage interconnected technology initiatives involving multiple teams, systems, stakeholders and dependencies.

  
  

**Outcome Orientation**

  
  

Focus on measurable delivery outcomes rather than simply tracking activities.

  
  

**Problem Solving**

  
  

Identify root causes, formulate options and drive resolution rather than acting only as an escalation mechanism.

  
  

**Cross-Functional Influence**

  
  

Influence priorities and outcomes across teams without relying on direct reporting authority.

  
  

**Strategic Context**

  
  

Understand how individual initiatives contribute to wider technology, reliability and operational objectives.

  
  

**Continuous Improvement**

  
  

Improve delivery processes, governance and operating practices rather than simply following established processes.

  
  

**Mentoring & Knowledge Sharing**

  
  

Support and mentor less-experienced delivery practitioners and help increase delivery capability across the organization.

  
  

**Stakeholder Credibility**

  
  

Communicate confidently with engineers, delivery leaders, business stakeholders, partners and senior technology leadership.

  
  

**Experience & Qualifications**
**Required**

  

  
* 7+ years of experience in technology delivery, technical project/program management or a related technology-delivery discipline.
  
  
* Experience independently managing complex technology initiatives involving multiple workstreams and cross-functional dependencies.
  
  
* Strong understanding of modern technology operations, cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, SRE or observability environments.
  
  
* Strong delivery planning, risk management, dependency management and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  
  
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical initiatives into structured delivery plans.
  
  
* Experience operating in large enterprise technology environments.
  
  
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  
  
* Strong executive and technical communication skills.
  
  
* Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes without direct authority.
  

  

**Preferred**

  

  
* Experience delivering Observability, SRE, Platform Engineering or Cloud Engineering initiatives.
  
  
* Familiarity with observability concepts including metrics, logs, traces, APM, alerting, dashboards and operational telemetry.
  
  
* Exposure to technologies such as
  **New Relic, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk and OpenTelemetry**
  .
  
  
* Experience working with Jira, Confluence or equivalent delivery-management platforms.
  
  
* Understanding of ITSM and incident-management practices.
  
  
* Experience working with enterprise technology partners or managed-service providers.
  
  
* Agile, Scrum, ITIL, PMP or equivalent certification/experience.
  

  

Pearson's environment currently uses New Relic as a centralized observability service, alongside other technologies including Datadog, Splunk and native hyperscaler alerting, with Jira Service Management and ServiceNow forming part of the service-management landscape.

  
  

**What Success Looks Like**

  
  

Success in this role means:

  
  

**Predictable Delivery**

  
  

Observability Engineering and NOC initiatives have clear ownership, plans, dependencies and measurable progress.

  
  

**Scalable Onboarding**

  
  

Services move through Observability and operational-readiness onboarding using repeatable processes rather than ad-hoc coordination.

  
  

**Operational Readiness**

  
  

Observability signals translate into well-defined triage, action and escalation pathways.

  
  

**Reduced Delivery Friction**

  
  

Cross-functional dependencies and blockers are identified early and resolved before they materially impact commitments.

  
  

**Executive Visibility**

  
  

Leadership has concise, accurate and actionable visibility of delivery progress, risks and decisions.

  
  

**Continuous Improvement**

  
  

The role leaves processes, governance and operating practices stronger than it found them.

  
  

**Trusted Delivery Leadership**

  
  

Engineering teams and leadership see the Technology Delivery Manager as the person who brings structure to complex initiatives and arrives with options when delivery problems emerge.

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

title: Integrated CX Strategy - Experienced Associate
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As an Integrated CX Strategy - Experienced Associate, you will engage in providing consulting services focused on customer-related strategies and initiatives. You will analyze client needs, develop customer-centric solutions, and offer guidance to help clients enhance their customer experience and drive business growth. As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagement and projects while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful client connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will specialize in enhancing the overall customer experience within our Commercial & Service Excellence practice. You will analyze customer touchpoints, design customer journey maps, and offer guidance to help clients create seamless and personalized experiences that drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy. This position offers a dynamic environment where you will be encouraged to take ownership and consistently deliver work that drives value for clients and success for the team. Embrace the opportunity to build your brand and open doors to more opportunities as you navigate through the firm.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We are looking for customer-focused, business-first professionals who can operate across strategy, design, operations, product, and technology. This is a hands-on consulting role for individuals who can structure ambiguous problems, facilitate stakeholder alignment, and convert experience opportunities into implementation-ready business and functional requirements. Ideal candidates will have:
  
  
Relevant experience in customer experience strategy, service design, digital transformation, product delivery, or business analysis within consulting or a global delivery environment.
  
  
Understanding customer experience frameworks, human-centered design, journey mapping, service blueprinting, operating models, governance, and experience measurement.
  
  
Hands-on experience conducting discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, qualitative or quantitative research, and current-state assessments.
  
  
Strong business analysis capabilities, including requirements of elicitation, process decomposition, functional analysis, traceability, prioritization, and solution validation.
  
  
Experience translating research, business objectives, operational needs, and technology constraints into clear experience concepts and actionable requirements.
  
  
Familiarity with digital experience ecosystems, including CRM, customer portals, commerce, marketing technology, contact centers, service management, identity, data, analytics, and integration platforms.
  
  
Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices, including epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, backlog refinement, sprint readiness, and release prioritization.
  
  
Ability to connect frontstage customer interactions with backstage processes, roles, systems, data, controls, and organizational capabilities.
  
  
Strong analytical thinking, synthesis, problem-solving, facilitation, and executive communication skills.
  
  
What You Must Have
  
  

* Bachelor's and/or MBA in Sales / Marketing / Strategy/ Analytics from a premier B-School
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required
* Lead CX strategy and/or business analysis workstreams, from discovery and experience definition through requirements, prioritization, implementation support, and business readiness.
* Structure complex customer and business problems into clear insights, strategic recommendations, experience concepts, requirements, process models, and implementation priorities.
* Facilitate senior stakeholder discussions, workshops, and decision-making sessions.
* Own the quality, completeness, and consistency of key client deliverables.
* Drive requirements clarification, prioritization, scope, and MVP decisions.
* Identify and manage risks, dependencies, assumptions, and cross-functional issues.
* Coordinate effectively across business, product, design, architecture, data, technology, and delivery teams.
* Guide implementation and business-readiness activities through testing, release, adoption, and optimization.
* Guide Associates and peers in strategy methods and deliverables, providing direction and review across research, synthesis, journey mapping, service blueprinting, strategic frameworks, and storytelling.
* Maintain accountability for workstream outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and delivery quality.
* Lead defined CX strategy workstreams, independently planning and driving research, current-state assessment, persona and journey development, service blueprinting, market analysis, future-state experience definition, and opportunity identification.
* Structure ambiguous customer and business problems into a clear strategic approach, determining the questions to answer, inputs required, analyses needed, and experience frameworks to apply.
* Synthesize customer research, market insights, business priorities, operational realities, and data into a clear point of view, identifying the implications and recommendations that matter most to the client.
* Shape future-state experience strategies and transformation roadmaps, connecting customer needs and experience opportunities to business value, capabilities, operating model implications, technology needs, and implementation priorities.
* Lead CX-focused client workshops and working sessions, including discovery, journey mapping, co-creation, prioritization, and future-state visioning, and drive stakeholders toward decisions and alignment.
* Own the strategic storyline and quality of CX deliverables, translating complex findings into clear executive-level narratives and confidently presenting recommendations to client stakeholders.

**Skills Preferred**
Candidates should be able to demonstrate customer transformation consulting capabilities across the following areas:
  
  
**CX Strategy, Research & Experience Design**

* Plan and conduct stakeholder interviews, discovery workshops, customer research, and co-creation sessions to understand customer expectations, pain points, business priorities, and operational constraints.
* Synthesize research and workshop outputs into insights, personas, journey maps, experience principles, opportunity areas, and measurable experience outcomes.
* Define future-state customer and employee experiences across web, mobile, portals, contact centers, sales, service, marketing, and other assisted or digital channels.
* Create journey maps, service blueprints, experience blueprints, ecosystem maps, and future-state experience visions.
* Develop CX strategies, capability roadmaps, MVP recommendations, and phased transformation plans that balance customer value, business impact, feasibility, and delivery risk.
* Apply market research, customer insights, analytics, and emerging experience trends to identify opportunities and shape strategic recommendations.
* Ability to work with clients to understand detailed requirements define end-to-end CX strategies that meet client needs and vision.
* Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions, and a deep understanding of mobile-first and responsive design.
* A solid grasp of user-centered design (UCD), planning and conducting design research, user testing.
* Experience in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, including interviews, surveys, journey mapping & workshops.
* Strong analytical and synthesis skills: ability to translate complex, ambiguous research data into clear strategic frameworks, insights, and recommendations.
* Experience creating service blueprints, ecosystem maps, and future-state experience visions that connect frontstage customer interactions with backstage operations and systems.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in fast-paced, cross-functional, and client-facing environments.
* Passion for customer experience strategy, innovation, and solving complex user and business challenges.
* Be passionate about all things CX Strategy, experience innovation. UX and other areas of design and innovation.
* Research and showcase knowledge in the industry’s latest trends and technologies.
* Ability to communicate ideas visually through low-fidelity wireframes, workflows, sketches, or conceptual prototypes.
* Ability to leverage generative AI tools to accelerate research synthesis, insight generation, persona development, and strategic storytelling.
* Familiar with AI-assisted workflows to optimize strategic and design outputs.

**Business Process, Experience & Requirements Design**

* Lead engagement with senior client stakeholders across business, product, customer experience, design, architecture, data, operations, and technology teams to understand strategic objectives, customer needs, operational challenges, and solution requirements.
* Lead discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, requirements elicitation sessions, process walkthroughs, and collaborative design sessions.
* Conduct current-state assessments across people, process, technology, data, and governance, and define future-state processes, operating models, experience improvements, and capability roadmaps.
* Develop customer journeys, service blueprints, experience flows, process maps, ecosystem maps, use cases, personas, and other artifacts that connect customer interactions with supporting business processes and systems.
* Document business processes, business rules, functional requirements, non-functional considerations, data needs, assumptions, dependencies, risks, controls, and decision points.
* Translate customer insights, experience concepts, and business needs into structured epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, and solution notes.
* Lead fit-gap analysis, impact assessments, option analysis, and prioritization exercises to support solution decisions, MVP definition, roadmap development, and scope management.
* Define success measures, KPIs, and reporting requirements to evaluate customer experience, process performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
* Maintain traceability from customer insights and business objectives through requirements, design, development, testing, and release.
* Create reusable documentation, frameworks, playbooks, templates, and quality standards to promote consistency, scalability, and effective knowledge transfer.

**Implementation & Business Delivery Support**

* Perform Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Product Owner, or Project Management responsibilities across customer experience, CRM, service, commerce, portal, and digital transformation implementations.
* Collaborate with product owners, UX designers, architects, developers, data teams, platform specialists, testing teams, and delivery leads to translate approved requirements into implementation-ready deliverables.
* Review wireframes, prototypes, workflows, data requirements, integration considerations, and functional designs to confirm alignment with customer journeys, business requirements, accessibility expectations, and operational processes.
* Refine and prioritize product backlogs, clarify requirements, resolve ambiguity, define MVP boundaries, and prepare user stories for sprint execution.
* Facilitate backlog refinement, sprint planning, solution walkthroughs, requirements validation, and stakeholder review sessions within Agile delivery environments.
* Support the implementation of customer-facing platforms and enterprise applications, including Salesforce, Adobe Experience Cloud, Oracle, CRM, customer service, commerce, content management, data, and analytics solutions.
* Identify cross-functional dependencies, integrations, data requirements, risks, controls, and change impacts early in the implementation lifecycle.
* Support data mapping, data quality, access, governance, migration, integration, and reporting requirements across platforms and supporting systems.
* Define expected outcomes and business scenarios for system integration testing and user acceptance testing.
* Review test results and defects, support defect triage, clarify expected system behavior, and validate that delivered functionality meets agreed business and customer needs.
* Use generative AI responsibly to accelerate requirements elicitation, process analysis, documentation, traceability, test-scenario development, quality reviews, and stakeholder communications.
* Support adoption of AI-enabled capabilities by translating new functionality into process changes, role impacts, training needs, operating procedures, and change-management requirements.
* Support release readiness, business validation, training, stakeholder communications, adoption planning, and post-implementation optimization.

**Client, Change & Practice Contribution**

* Contribute to customer experience and business transformation engagements, including implementation roadmaps, operating model changes, adoption planning, and change management.
* Develop stakeholder communications, training materials, process guidance, and enablement content to support solution adoption.
* Coordinate across business, product, design, technology, and delivery teams to manage dependencies, risks, decisions, and implementation readiness.
* Develop high-quality client-facing presentations, executive summaries, proposals, and recommendations.
* Participate in business development activities, including proposal development, solution design, capability demonstrations, and creation of reusable assets.

**Tools & System**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Suite and strategic storytelling tools is a must. Working knowledge of Miro or equivalent workshop facilitation tools is required. Familiarity with UX tools like Figma, Guidewire is a must.
* Experience with AI-assisted research and design tools.
* Business Analyst - Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Adobe Experience Cloud, Google Analytics, and other leading tools.

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Computer Engineering, Information CyberSecurity, Computer and Information Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Computer Applications
* Demonstrating intellectual curiosity and adaptability in fast-paced environments
* Utilizing customer journey analysis to enhance client engagement strategies
* Applying customer experience (CX) design principles to drive value propositions
* Excelling in communication and active listening to foster client relationships
* Developing business process improvement strategies for customer satisfaction
* Leveraging customer segmentation techniques to optimize service delivery

description:

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Job Summary
  
  
Provide technical leadership to a group of Software Engineers & QA engineers. As an enthusiastic technologist, you will stay up-to-date with technological trends in the industry and continuously motivate engineers to leverage the best-in-class technology in building enterprise-scale software.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide technical leadership to a group of backend and frontend developers & QA engineers.
* Actively engage with the team to provide technical and architectural guidance in building the next-gen Identity Security Platform.
* Participate in continuous and iterative software development cycles with emphasis on code quality, supportability, scalability and performance.
* Ensure solid software engineering principles are adopted such as unit test automation, code reviews, and continuous integration.
* Mentor and coach other engineers, and ensure adherence to security coding guidelines.
* Manage the engineers’ career growth and aspirations.
* Work with other engineering teams, Product Management and field professionals to understand customer requirements for continuous product enhancements.
* Interface with the Support team to handle customer escalation issues; diagnose and fix product issues.
* Assist engineering leadership in hiring.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* BE / B Tech /MCA or equivalent.
* 12+ years of hands-on experience in the design & development of building enterprise software.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience leading a software development team as a tech/team lead.
* Expertise and hands-on experience with backend development tech stack - Python/Java/C#/Node js/Go or any similar backend stack on Cloud development ecosystem (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Being full-stack or knowledge of React/Typescript based development is an added advantage.
* Good understanding of security and best practices.
* Experience with Agile, TDD, test methodologies and industry-standard automation testing frameworks.
* Experience in creating technical and architectural documents.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, as well as strong interpersonal skills.
* Ability to handle ambiguity and collaborate across multiple groups and disciplines.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks concurrently and drive them to successful completion.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the development of cloud-based solutions, AWS will be a plus.
* Working experience with AWS Serverless architecture would be a plus.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

description:

At IDBS, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

At IDBS, we provide innovative software solutions and services that empower scientists and researchers to accelerate their discoveries, by helping them design, execute and orchestrate processes, manage, contextualize and structure their data and gain valuable insights throughout the drug lifecycle, from R&D through manufacturing. As part of Danaher’s connected ecosystem, we partner closely with customers to solve their toughest challenges with greater speed and certainty. We work with 75% of the top 20 global biopharma companies\*. Join us at IDBS to continuously grow and make a real impact, working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about our mission and each other.
  
  

* Rank measured by Market Cap, Q2 2026.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
  
  
The
**PMO Analyst**
supports project governance, reporting, forecasting, data quality, audit readiness, and continuous improvement across a global portfolio of Life Sciences software-as-a-service implementation projects. This internal-facing role helps establish consistent ways of working, maintain trusted project data, strengthen delivery discipline, and apply artificial intelligence tools and agents to improve Project Management Office productivity and reporting quality.
  
  
This position is located onsite in Bangalore, India and is part of the Global Professional Services team. The role will report to a Professional Services leader and partner closely with Project Managers, implementation teams, and Finance across regions and time zones.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Support the planning, coordination, tracking, and closure of multiple concurrent software-as-a-service implementation projects by maintaining accurate project plans, actions, RAID logs, milestone records, and delivery documentation.

* Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 5% including occasional overnight travel

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
