title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Our Business Analyst plays a vital role as the "glue" in our project/task team. As our primary inhouse
  
  
client advocate, the Business Analyst works closely with the stakeholders, technical
  
  
team, and SMEs to lead and facilitate discussions to understand the client's needs, ask clarifying
  
  
questions, discuss alternative scenarios, and turn them into requirements. Once the
  
  
requirements are captured, the Business Analyst will work closely with our technical team
  
  
(product owners, project manager, development manager, and technical lead) to help design
  
  
and develop a solution to meet the client's requirements. Throughout the project's life, the
  
  
Business Analyst's primary responsibility is representing the client and ensuring all deliverables
  
  
align with the project's vision. This involves working with virtually every member of the project
  
  
team, both internal and client-facing, to facilitate communication, review the quality of
  
  
deliverables, and ensure project success.
  
  
To be successful as a Business Analyst, you should be a self-driven and curious person with
  
  
great attention to detail. Since the Business Analyst role is the "glue" for all projects, strong
  
  
verbal and written communication skills are a priority, has the ability to work with a vast array
  
  
of project team members. More importantly, one must have and interest in problem-solving, a
  
  
positive attitude, and a willingness to learn. Ultimately, working as a Business Analyst, you will
  
  
learn to quickly break down and understand varying business processes, help to identify gaps or
  
  
areas for improvement in those processes, and then translate those into requirements via
  
  
visual and written documentation. Because our clients span a wide range of internal
  
  
organizational styles, no two projects are the same, and Analyst bridges the gap between
  
  
operational and technical resources. Our Business Analysts should be able to follow our
  
  
standard project processes and adjust those processes on the fly to meet the needs of the
  
  
client or project.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Assist the Business Analyst team in working with the client to:
  
  

* Assess, research, analyze and document sponsor/stakeholder/request needs.
* Identify and diagnose business problems and potential solutions.
* Develop and maintain project documentation related to the business requirements (for

example, User requirements, use cases, wireframes, process flows, site maps, etc.)
  
  

* Develop and maintain a strong relationship with internal/external team members.
* Identify issues in a project and escalate/manage resolution as required.
* Coordinate and provide support to the business with the process implementation.
* Advocate for clients during Sprint cycles to govern workstreams, compliance to

requirements, and ensure timelines.
  
  

* Assist with organizing UAT structure, testing, goals, and results.
* Provide timely updates and communication to entire project/task team.

Work with our internal project team to:
  
  

* Represent the client in all aspects of a project.
* Support the team in planning, development, stabilization, and deployment of user

requirements to the overall workflow.
  
  

* Support the team in identifying potential solutions, roadblocks, and issues.
* Review user requirements with the technical team at the start of the project to ensure

they understand the project requirements
  
  

* Identify and escalate gaps in the proposed solution to ensure we are meeting all client

requirements.
  
  

* Check-in with the support development team to answer any questions and help clear

roadblocks.
  
  

* Perform quality assurance testing on all deliverables before releasing them to the client.
* Provide knowledge transfer and training as needed to assist with the transition to other

internal teams.
  
  

* Audit and improve internal processes as needed.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree or related work experience
  
  

* 4+ years experience as a Business Analyst or similar role
* Experience using Jira or equivalent software planning system
* Assess, research, analyze and document sponsor/stakeholder/requester needs
* General understanding of Agile and Sprint organization and planning
* Develop and maintain project documentation related to the business requirements (for

example, User requirements, use cases, wireframes, process flows, modeling, etc.)
  
  

* Experience in process design, including developing and executing process improvements
* Experience with Replicon, a plus

Other Requirements:
  
  

* Project Management experience and knowledge desired
* Experience in eDiscovery not required but preferred
* Experience and knowledge with coding and SQL queries a plus
* Knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies; programming logic and work-flow concepts; and test planning, coordination and execution
* Proficient in Microsoft Suite of Products (Power BI, Excel, OneNote, Teams, etc.)

title: ServiceNow Business Analyst: ITSM
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The ServiceNow Business Analyst (ITSM specialism) is a key member of the NTT DATA ServiceNow Practice, embedded within a product domain and working closely with the Product Owner, Delivery Manager, and development team. The role is responsible for gathering, translating, and managing business requirements through the full delivery lifecycle — from stakeholder workshops through to development story creation, testing coordination, and release sign-off.
  
  
The BA acts as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery, ensuring that what is built accurately reflects the outcomes the business needs and aligns to the product roadmap. Although domain-aligned, the BA is part of a shared pool and may support other capability areas when capacity requires.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and facilitate workshops with business stakeholders to elicit, capture, and validate requirements, ensuring outcomes and objectives are clearly understood before entering the development pipeline.
* Translate business requirements into clearly written, development-ready user stories, acceptance criteria, and process maps in line with the agreed product roadmap.
* Own and maintain the requirements backlog for the product domain, keeping stories refined, prioritised, and ready for sprint intake in collaboration with the Product Owner.
* Support the Sprint Intake Review by ensuring stories are sufficiently detailed and acceptance criteria are agreed before development begins.
* Coordinate and actively participate in functional testing and UAT, validating that developed functionality meets the defined acceptance criteria and business outcome.
* Act as a liaison between the business and QA function to ensure test cases are aligned to requirements and that business stakeholders are engaged in sign-off activities.
* Identify and document scope changes, risks, and dependencies, escalating to the Delivery Manager and Product Owner where appropriate.
* Contribute to Release Readout sessions, supporting communication of what has been delivered and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
* Maintain clear and accurate requirements documentation throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring traceability from requirement through to delivery.
* Support the ITSM Product Owner in refining the ITSM/ITOM/ITAM/SAM roadmap by providing detailed requirements context for incoming demand.
* Document and optimise IT service management processes — including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Asset workflows — ensuring alignment to ServiceNow best practice and ITIL principles.
* Engage with IT operations stakeholders to understand service desk and operations pain points, translating these into platform improvements.

**Essential Experience & Skills**

* Proven experience as a Business Analyst in an enterprise IT or digital transformation environment.
* Strong skills in requirements elicitation, workshop facilitation, and stakeholder management across multiple levels of seniority.
* Experience writing high-quality user stories and acceptance criteria for agile development teams.
* Ability to coordinate and support testing activities, including defining test scenarios, coordinating UAT, and managing sign-off processes.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills — able to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile delivery environment with multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Demonstrable experience working on ServiceNow ITSM implementations or enhancements, with a solid understanding of ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, or SAM modules.
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and how they translate into ServiceNow configuration.
* Experience engaging with IT operations teams, service desk functions, or technology stakeholders as part of requirements gathering.

**Desirable**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or relevant product certification.
* Experience working in a product-led, platform delivery model.
* Familiarity with Now Create methodology or ServiceNow implementation best practice.
* Experience with Agile tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or ServiceNow Agile Development.

**Behaviours & Competencies**

* Outcome-focused — driven by business value, not just task completion.
* Collaborative — builds trust with business stakeholders and delivery teams alike.
* Detail-oriented — takes pride in the quality and accuracy of requirements and documentation.
* Proactive — surfaces risks, gaps, and opportunities without waiting to be asked.
* Adaptable — comfortable operating in a shared pool model across different capability domains

Hybrid Working

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  
year in R&D.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Salesforce
description:
SO, WHAT'S THE STORY?
  
  
The DTC Customer Service team is part of the broader Direct To Consumer (DTC) team, which aligns with our corporate strategy of putting our customers and our direct relationships with our customers first. We strive to be a customer-centric division, using the latest technologies and innovations to serve our customers in a manner that is authentic with the brand values.
  
  
The Business Analyst in the DTC Customer Service team Team will play a pivotal role in an agile delivery environment, focusing on optimizing and enhancing Salesforce Service Cloud capabilities. This role involves partnering with business stakeholders, customer service teams, technology teams, and external vendors to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and ensure successful delivery of solutions that improve customer support operations and customer experience.
  
  
THE GIG
  
  
As a Business Analyst, you will:
  
  

* Partner with Product Managers, Delivery Managers, and Customer Service Operations teams to capture, prioritize, and translate business requirements into actionable Salesforce Service Cloud solutions.
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Customer Support, Digital Experience, and Technology teams to understand business needs and identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Analyze and document as- is customer service processes, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, service quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Act as the bridge between business and technology, translating complex business needs into clear technical specifications for development teams.
* Facilitate workshops, requirement gathering sessions, process mapping exercises, and solution reviews with business stakeholders.
* Support integration initiatives between Salesforce Service Cloud and other enterprise systems. Collaborate with SFSC Administrators, developers, QA team, and integration teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Communicate progress, risks, and dependencies clearly to stakeholders, maintaining transparency throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Provide ongoing support and training to users on new systems and processes, ensuring adoption and continuous improvement.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for business processes, technical specifications, and system configurations.

THE STUFF THAT SETS YOU APART
  
  
**Must-Have Skills:**

* Proven experience as a Business Analyst for Salesforce Service Cloud solutions in an agile delivery environment.
* Strong platform awareness of Salesforce Service Cloud capabilities and customer service operations.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, creating user stories, acceptance criteria, and process workflows.
* Advanced understanding of customer support processes, case management workflows, service operations, and customer experience best practices.
* Experience of facilitating workshops and engaging stakeholders across business and technical teams.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Technical Skills:**

* Proficiency in Salesforce Service Cloud.
* Familiarity with Salesforce platform architecture and data models.
* Familiarity with agile methodologies and tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).
* Experience with data analysis and reporting tools.
* Understanding of integration technologies, APIs and enterprise systems.
* Knowledge of SQL and database management.

**Soft Skills:**

* Communication: Clearly articulating business requirements and technical concepts to stakeholders.
* Collaboration: Working effectively with cross-functional teams to achieve common goals.
* Adaptability: Being flexible and open to changes in a dynamic, agile environment.
* Problem-solving: Approaching challenges with a solution-oriented mindset.
* Attention to Detail: Ensuring accuracy and thoroughness in documentation and analysis.
* Time Management: Prioritising tasks and managing time efficiently to meet deadlines.
* Empathy: Understanding user needs and perspectives to create user-friendly solutions.
* Continuous Learning: Staying updated with the latest industry trends and technologies.
* Strategic Thinking: Aligning business analysis efforts with organisational goals and objectives.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Relevant Salesforce certifications are a plus (eg: Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Business Analyst, Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant) are a plus.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster, PMI-ACP, SAFe Agilist) are a plus.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience in the retail, ecommerce or B2C industry, particularly within global customer service operations.
* Proven track record of collaborating with cross-functional technology teams in front-end development or customer experience projects.
* Experience in analysing and mapping agent workflows, and familiarity with Contact Center technologies, CTI integrations, and AI-powered service capabilities.

title: Senior Manager, Data Product Strategy & Analytics
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
  
  
This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
The Senior Manager, Data & Analytics Products owns a portfolio of enterprise-critical Tier 1 products from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption, service performance, and value realization. The role connects executive and business priorities to product roadmaps and leads across product, data engineering, analytics, governance, architecture, security, operations, and business teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a data and analytics leader with strong product judgment: commercially grounded, technically fluent, practical in the application of AI, and skilled at aligning senior stakeholders and global delivery teams. Success requires the ability to make enterprise data trusted, analytics products useful, and complex strategic programs executable - without requiring hands-on engineering or model development.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Tier 1 insights product portfolio strategy. Own the vision, value proposition, target users, product criticality, investment priorities, outcome metrics, and multi-horizon roadmaps for the company's most important data and analytics products. Balance run, grow, and transform priorities across the portfolio.
* Discovery and product lifecycle. Lead stakeholder interviews, user research, decision-journey and process analysis, and opportunity sizing. Translate important business questions into product requirements, priorities, roadmaps, success measures, and an ongoing improvement agenda.
* Product reliability and performance. Define business-critical expectations for accuracy, freshness, consistency, usability, adoption, and support. Partner with Data Engineering team on availability, incident response, and technical remediation while maintaining transparent product-health reporting.
* Trusted data and governance. Establish clear ownership, shared definitions, lineage, and quality expectations for each product. Partner with Data Governance, Security, Privacy, and IT to ensure access, retention, and control requirements are appropriately addressed.
* Advanced analytics and applied AI. Identify where predictive analytics, generative AI, intelligent decision support, or automation can improve a user outcome. Shape prototypes and scalable solutions with clear evaluation measures, monitoring, explainability, controls, and human oversight.
* Executive priorities and strategic execution. Act as a trusted execution partner to senior leaders. Translate priorities into product investments, workstreams, owners, milestones, and decision forums; manage risks and dependencies; and prepare concise business cases, executive updates, and recommendations.
* Adoption and value realization. Lead launch, enablement, communications, and stakeholder engagement. Build feedback loops and measure adoption, satisfaction, decision effectiveness, productivity, revenue, cost, and risk outcomes to demonstrate and improve product value.
* Team and delivery leadership. Lead and develop product managers, analysts, and program resources while creating shared accountability across data engineering, analytics, architecture, governance, business teams, and vendors. Resolve trade-offs and sustain predictable, high-quality delivery.

We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the {{OFFICE\_LOCATION}} office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.
  
  
**What You Bring**

* 15+ years of progressive experience across data and analytics, data-product management, strategic program leadership, transformation, or closely related roles, including leadership of complex enterprise initiatives.
* Demonstrated ownership of enterprise-critical data, analytics, reporting, master-data, or AI products from strategy and business case through delivery, operations, adoption, and measurable impact.
* Strong product-management fundamentals across portfolio strategy, discovery, prioritization, roadmaps, stakeholder governance, product performance, adoption, experimentation, and value realization.
* Sufficient technical fluency to translate business needs and make informed trade-offs with Data Engineering, Architecture, Security, and platform teams. Hands-on engineering, architecture, or platform administration is not required.
* Applied AI fluency, including the ability to identify valuable use cases, assess data readiness and risk, shape user and control requirements, and validate adoption and outcomes in partnership with technical teams.
* Experience defining business expectations and measures for accuracy, freshness, usability, adoption, stakeholder satisfaction, and value, while partnering with technical owners on availability, service levels, and support models.
* Track record of leading multidisciplinary teams and influencing senior executives, business owners, technical leaders, and global partners through competing priorities, risks, dependencies, and decisions.
* Strong commercial, financial, written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including opportunity sizing, business cases, resource planning, executive reporting, and concise product storytelling

**What You Can Expect From Us**

* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
  
  
**Accommodations And Accessibility**
Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
  
  
**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
  
  
Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
  
  
**Join us and bring your best.**
**Bring your bold.**
**Pure and simple.**

title: Data Analyst (Finance & Validation): Internship → Full-Time
description:
**Affluense.ai · Bengaluru (On-site) · Internship with conversion to full-time**

**About Affluense**

Affluense is an AI-powered wealth intelligence platform used by leading wealth managers, banks and BFSI firms across India. We track who’s creating wealth, where money is moving and what’s happening in the market, and we turn that into intelligence our customers act on every day.

Our customers make real decisions based on what we deliver, so every number has to be right.

**The Role**

You’ll be the analytical gatekeeper of our intelligence. Before anything reaches a customer, you make sure it’s accurate, complete and makes sense. You’ll work closely with the founders and the data team, reviewing financial information, deal activity and wealth signals, and catching what others miss.

This role suits someone who enjoys cross-checking a figure until it adds up, who notices when something looks slightly off, and who follows the markets out of genuine interest.

**What you’ll do**

* Review and verify financial data, company information and deal activity for accuracy and consistency
* Cross-reference information across multiple sources and resolve any discrepancies
* Spot anomalies, gaps and patterns in large datasets
* Build Excel models and Python scripts that automate repetitive checks and make the team faster
* Track funding rounds, exits, M&A, IPOs and other money movements across India’s market
* Help define and improve our data quality standards as we scale

**What we’re looking for**

* Quick and sharp with numbers. You enjoy working with them.
* Obsessive attention to detail. Small errors bother you.
* Strong hands-on Excel skills: lookups, pivots, formulas, data cleaning
* Working knowledge of Python (pandas is a plus), especially for automating tasks
* A real interest in finance: startups, funding, markets, wealth creation and how money moves
* Comfortable reading financial statements, deal announcements and business news
* Final-year students or recent graduates in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Engineering, Statistics or a related field

**Bonus points**

* You follow deal news (Entrackr, Inc42, VCCircle, ET) for fun
* CFA Level 1 or NISM certification, or currently pursuing one
* You’ve built a tracker, model or automation on your own initiative

**Why join us**

* Direct exposure to founders and how a fast-growing, funded AI startup operates
* A clear path from internship to a full-time role, based on performance
* A front-row view of India’s wealth and deal ecosystem
* Real ownership: your work goes straight to the customers

title: Senior UI/UX Designer
description:
**About GoSuper EdTech**
At GoSuper EdTech, we are a team of passionate innovators dedicated to reshaping the education sector through cutting-edge technology.
  
  
Our mission is to make high-quality education accessible, efficient, and impactful for everyone. With a global footprint and a deep understanding of local needs, we bridge traditional education with modern, AI-driven solutions.
  
  
We're building a new kind of learning platform — where community, AI, and SaaS intersect to create scalable, personalized experiences for millions of learners.
  
  
If you're driven by high-impact challenges, product ownership, and meaningful work, GoSuper offers a front-row seat to the future of education technology.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer with 2+ years of hands-on experience to design intuitive, scalable, and user-centric digital experiences across web and mobile platforms.
  
  
In this role, you will work closely with product managers, engineers, marketers, and founders to translate complex requirements into simple, elegant user experiences. You will take ownership of UX decisions, contribute to design systems, and mentor junior designers when needed.
  
  
Your work will directly impact parents, teachers, schools, and learners using GoSuper’s platforms every day.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design intuitive and engaging user experiences for web and mobile products
* Translate product requirements and user needs into wireframes, flows, and prototypes
* Create high-quality UI designs aligned with brand guidelines and design systems
* Conduct user research, usability testing, and incorporate feedback into designs
* Maintain and evolve design systems, components, and interaction patterns
* Collaborate closely with product managers to define UX strategy and priorities
* Work with engineers to ensure accurate and efficient design implementation
* Ensure designs meet accessibility and usability standards (WCAG basics
* Review designs for consistency, clarity, and scalability across platforms
* Participate in design critiques, reviews, and cross-functional discussions
* Mentor junior designers and contribute to a strong design culture
* Continuously improve UX based on analytics, user behavior, and feedback

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 2+ years of professional experience in UI/UX or Product Design
* Strong portfolio showcasing UX thinking, problem-solving, and UI craft
* Proficiency with modern design tools (Figma preferred)
* Solid understanding of UX principles, usability heuristics, and design thinking
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs
* Familiarity with responsive and mobile-first design approaches
* Understanding of design systems and component-based design
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Attention to detail with a user-first mindset

Nice to Have (Not Mandatory)
  
  

* Experience designing SaaS, EdTech, or consumer-facing products
* Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG)
* Experience working closely with frontend engineers
* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS for design handoff
* Experience conducting usability testing or user interviews
* Prior experience mentoring or guiding junior designers

What You’ll Gain
  
  

* Ownership of UX for real products used by parents, teachers, and schools
* Opportunity to shape and scale design systems from an early stage
* Close collaboration with senior product and engineering leaders
* Exposure to the complete product lifecycle — from discovery to delivery
* Freedom to influence UX decisions and product direction
* Access to Cult Elite and Cult Play Pass for wellness and fitness
* Clear growth path into Lead UI/UX Designer / Design Manager roles

**Compensation**

* Competitive salary aligned with experience and impact
* Performance-based bonuses in a high-growth startup
* Flexible remote work with the option to work from our Bengaluru office
* Learning & development budget for courses and certifications
* Wellness benefits including Cult Elite membership and Cult Play Pass
* Transparent, inclusive, and ownership-driven company culture

Life at GoSuper EdTech
  
  
At GoSuper, engineers are creators. We value curiosity, ownership, and fast iteration. You’ll work on meaningful problems and build tools that touch the lives of real users every day.
  
  
We're building with purpose - and we're looking for like-minded people who want to build with us.
  
  
Apply via mail
  
  
Send your application through mail to with your resume and a short note. Mention the specific role in the subject line.
  
  
Mention “Senior UI/UX Designer” in the subject line.
  
  
Need Assistance?
  
  
Contact our HR team at +91 91117 47111 for any queries.

title: E-Commerce Product Designer
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**
Industry: Technology, Information and Internet
  
  
Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  
  
Experience: 5+ yrs
  
  
Location: Bangalore, Bengaluru
  
  
Job Type: Full-time
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on role with real ownership. You will be in front of users, in the numbers and in Figma, helping decide what gets built and why.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* User research. Usability testing, interviews, surveys and observational studies, planned and run by you, turned into findings the team acts on
* Wireframes and flows that settle the structure of a screen before anyone argues about pixels
* Benchmarking and competitor analysis as a continuous feed of best practice into the team, not a one-off deck
* End-to-end app design, from problem framing through to shipped, measured and iterated
* Internal platform apps for catalogue, operations and commercial teams, where saved clicks become saved hours
* Localisation quality across KSA and UAE: Arabic-first layouts and RTL integrity, not English translated late
* The design system in Figma, keeping the app coherent as it scales

**Requirements**
**How We Work With AI**
We are building an AI-native product team. We want a designer already working this way, not one curious about it.
  
  
  

* AI in the design loop: exploring directions, generating variants, and getting to wireframes and working prototypes in hours rather than days
* AI in research: turning interviews, session recordings, reviews and support tickets into patterns, at a volume manual synthesis cannot reach
* Judgement about it: knowing where AI accelerates the work and where it produces confident, generic output worth discarding

*Expect to walk us through a recent project and show us where AI did the work.*
**What We're Looking For**

* Native app and eCommerce expertise. Our iOS and Android apps are the core of this role. You know both platforms' conventions and where they diverge, you have designed inside an app release cycle, and you have shipped digital commerce: browse, search, product pages, cart and checkout
* Deep UX craft. Research, information architecture, flows and usability are your core, not a phase you pass through on the way to visuals
* Design that moves numbers. You start from the funnel and the drop-off, and you can say what a design was meant to change and whether it did
* MENA understanding. You will design for Saudi and UAE customers from Bangalore, which means learning that market deliberately rather than assuming patterns travel. Arabic and RTL experience is a strong plus
* Speed, across several things at once. Three or four projects at different stages without dropping any, shipping something good this sprint over something perfect next quarter
* Open to feedback, quick to iterate. You share work early and unfinished, invite criticism, and change direction on evidence without taking it personally
* Senior ownership. You frame a vague business problem yourself and drive it to be shipped. Strong bias for action, comfortable in ambiguity, communicates proactively

**Experience**

* 5+ years in product design, most of it on native iOS and Android apps shipped and live at scale
* eCommerce or digital commerce products designed end to end, with an understanding of how a conversion funnel behaves
* Hands-on research. You have planned and moderated your own interviews and usability tests, not commissioned them
* Expert in Figma: components, variables, prototyping and design system ownership
* A demonstrated AI-assisted workflow, whether Figma AI, Claude, image models or prototyping tools
* A portfolio that shows outcomes, not only screens. We will ask what changed and by how much
* Comfortable in analytics yourself: GA4, Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar
* Strong plus: marketplace or retail, internal tooling, Arabic and RTL design

Must-have skills
  
  
iOS, Android

title: UI/UX Designer - Web/Digital Marketing
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.
  
  
Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
  
  
**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
Candescent is seeking a thoughtful, detail-oriented UI/UX Designer to shape the look, feel, and usability of our website and digital experiences from one of our India office locations. You will design intuitive, on-brand experiences from wireframe through high-fidelity mockup, working closely with web, marketing, and product marketing teams to bring ideas to life.
  
  
This is a hands-on design role for someone who enjoys solving user problems through clean, purposeful design and who wants to see their work built and shipped quickly. You will work closely with the web development team to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Design & Delivery**

* Design wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity UI for web pages, landing pages, and digital experiences in Figma.
* Translate business goals and user needs into intuitive user flows and information architecture.
* Design and iterate on landing pages and campaign assets in support of marketing and demand generation initiatives.
* Support A/B testing initiatives by designing test variants for key pages and conversion flows.

**Design Systems & Consistency**

* Create and maintain a design system and component library to ensure visual consistency across the site.
* Apply Candescent brand standards consistently across all digital work, including typography, colour, iconography, and imagery.
* Ensure designs follow accessibility best practices (WCAG) and are optimised for performance.

**Research & Validation**

* Conduct or contribute to user research and usability testing, and gather feedback to inform design decisions.
* Use analytics and test results to identify usability problems and prioritise improvements.
* Stay current on design trends, tools, and best practices, and bring fresh ideas to the team.

**Collaboration & Ways of Working**

* Collaborate closely with the web development team to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively, and support a clean handoff.
* Partner with stakeholders across marketing, product marketing, and sales to gather requirements and present design concepts.
* Present and explain design decisions clearly, and incorporate feedback constructively.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.

**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*

* 3–5 years of experience in UI/UX design, preferably for web or digital marketing.
* Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout, and prototyping.
* Solid portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, typography, and layout skills.
* Understanding of responsive design principles and designing for multiple breakpoints and devices.
* Working knowledge of UX best practices, user flows, and information architecture.
* Ability to translate business and marketing goals into clear, user-centred design solutions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to present and explain design decisions to stakeholders.
* Detail-oriented, with a strong sense of visual polish and consistency.

**Qualifications & Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*

* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio will be considered.
* Hands-on experience building or editing sites in Webflow is preferred.
* Basic understanding of HTML and CSS and how designs translate to code is preferred.
* Experience with user research or usability testing methods is a plus.
* Familiarity with A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation principles is a plus.
* Experience designing for SEO-friendly page structures is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Designs are intuitive, on-brand, and elevate the overall user experience.
* Design-to-development handoff is smooth, with minimal rework needed.
* A well-maintained, scalable design system that speeds up future work.
* Measurable improvements in usability and conversion on redesigned pages.

description:
**About Kinaxis**
Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
  
  
In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
  
  
Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
  
  
Location
  
  
Bangalore
  
  
**About The Role**
The Learning Experience Designer at Kinaxis is responsible for the visual quality, usability, and accessibility of Training and Enablement content. This role focuses on how content is experienced by users, ensuring it is visually clear, intuitive, inclusive, and aligned with Kinaxis brand and experience standards.
  
  
This role partners closely with curriculum developers, infrastructure specialists, operations, and subject matter experts to elevate the structure, presentation, and overall learning experience, ensuring consistency and quality across how training content is designed, delivered, and encountered. The ideal candidate brings strong visual design judgment, a user-centered‑ mindset, and the ability to assess whether learning experiences meet quality, tone, and clarity standards for the intended audience.
  
  
Reporting to the Manager of Customer Education, this role helps ensure that Training and Enablement content is polished, consistent, and usable at scale, supporting customer success through thoughtful design and experience focused decisions.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Own and elevate the visual design and user experience of Training and Enablement content across formats.
* Work closely with curriculum developers to apply visual design principles (layout, hierarchy, typography, color, motion) to content, improving clarity and comprehension.
* Review learning materials to ensure visual and written content align with established standards, brand voice, and audience expectations.
* Ensure learning materials meet accessibility and inclusive design standards (e.g., WCAG), including color contrast, readable typography, and clear content structure.
* Design and produce high-quality multimedia assets such as diagrams, graphics, animations, video elements, and templates that support learning goals.
* Contribute to and maintain visual, accessibility, and content brand standards for Kinaxis Training and Enablement.
* Review existing materials and tools and suggest improvements to usability, consistency, processes, and overall experience.
* Advocate for user needs by applying UX principles and design thinking when evaluating content decisions.

Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in a design related field (e.g., graphic design, visual communication, digital media, UX/UI) or a related discipline.

What we are looking for
  
  

* 2+ years of experience in visual design, multimedia, or digital content design, ideally in a SaaS or technology environment.
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro).
* Demonstrated strength in visual design fundamentals, including layout, typography, color systems, hierarchy, and motion.
* Strong understanding of user ‑ centered design and design thinking principles, including accessibility and inclusive design, and how design decisions impact usability, comprehension, and overall user experience.
* Strong writing and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, constructive feedback on design and content quality.
* Detail oriented, creative, and thoughtful, with a commitment to high-quality, ‑user-centered‑ experiences while working within established brand and system guidelines.

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with web design concepts and basic HTML/CSS.
* Familiarity with instructional design.

**#Associate**
**#Intermediate**
**Work With Impact:**
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
  
  
**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:**
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
  
  
**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:**
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
  
  
People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:
  
  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs, training, and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .

We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**We’re Hiring: Graphic Designer**

A place to think outside the box, break a few rules, and make cool things.

At
**Köche**
, we’re building a premium kitchen appliance brand across BLDC chimneys, hobs, cooktops and water heaters. And we want someone who can bring the brand to life through great design.

We’re looking for a Graphic Designer (0–3 years) who has ideas, experiments with them, cares about the details, and knows that good design is about more than making things look pretty.

If you’ve ever opened Photoshop for “one tiny change” and emerged two hours later with 17 versions, we might get along.

**What you’ll be creating**

* Digital ads: Creatives for Meta, Google, Amazon and Flipkart.
* Social media: Fresh, engaging content that makes people stop scrolling.
* Website & email: Website visuals, landing pages and email creatives.
* E-commerce: Amazon A+ Content, Brand Store designs and marketplace assets.
* Brand & campaigns: Product launches, campaign concepts and promotional creatives.
* Print & retail: Catalogues, brochures, product collaterals and POSM.

Essentially, wherever Köche needs to show up, you'll help make it look good.

**What we’re looking for**

* You're comfortable with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and Figma.
* You have a strong eye for typography, colour, composition and the little details.
* You can turn a rough idea into a thoughtful, well-executed design.
* You understand that good design isn't just about aesthetics, it needs to communicate, connect and make an impact.
* You're curious, open to feedback and not afraid to try something different.
* You're interested in exploring AI tools and new ways to create.
* You have a portfolio that shows us how you think, experiment and solve creative problems.

Freshers are welcome! We care more about your creative thinking and portfolio than the number of years on your résumé.

**What makes this exciting?**

* Room to experiment: Bring new ideas, explore different styles and challenge the usual way of doing things.
* Real ownership: Take your designs from concept to execution and see them out in the world.
* Work that matters: Your creatives will reach real customers across digital platforms, e-commerce and retail.
* Work closely with decision-makers: Collaborate with our founders and marketing, product and sales teams.
* Keep growing: Build your skills, explore new tools and develop a portfolio of work you're proud to call your own.

No ideas gathering dust in a folder. No designing just for the sake of it. We want to make things that people notice.

📍 The details

Location: Bengaluru

Employment type: Full-time

title: Product Design Engineer- 4+ years of experience
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

 

For more information, visit


www.sonicwall.com

or follow us on


X,


LinkedIn

,


Facebook

, and


Instagram

.

 

**About the Role**

* We are looking for a hands-on
  **Product Designer**
  to join the
  **Unified Management Portal desig**
  n team and help shape the unified experience that powers our product portfolio.
* The Unified Management Portal consolidates SonicWall’s network, endpoint, email, and cloud security products into a single portal with shared SSO, navigation, and design system — a major product reset.
* This is a B2B, enterprise-grade product design role — not consumer. The designer will design for IT administrators, security analysts, network engineers, and managed service provider partners who manage security for organizations of every size, from SMBs to global enterprises.
* The work centers on density, configurability, scale, and operational reliability — not consumer-style minimalism or marketing surfaces.
* This is a builder’s role on a small, senior team. The designer will own design end to end for product areas with significant business impact, partner closely with Product and Engineering, and work in an AI-augmented design environment where Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own end-to-end design for one or more Unified Management Portal product areas, from discovery and information architecture through interaction design, visual polish, prototyping, and design QA.
* Design complex enterprise workflows including policy builders, dashboards, configuration wizards, multi-tenant management, alerting, and incident response screens.
* Build and maintain components, tokens, and patterns in the Unified Management Portal Figma design system.
* Generate working interactive prototypes using AI tools such as Claude, v0, Figma Make, and similar tools.
* Use Claude across the design workflow, including prototype generation, design-system documentation, research synthesis, content design, and competitive analysis.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, and Solution Architects across time zones.
* Contribute to design-system governance and documentation as the platform scales across product lines.
* Conduct usability reviews and design critiques, raising the quality bar across the team.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4–7 years of product design experience in B2B, enterprise SaaS. Consumer-only backgrounds are unlikely to be a strong fit.
* Expert-level proficiency in Figma, including auto-layout, variables, component libraries, variants, branching, and design-system contribution.
* Demonstrated fluency with Claude as a working tool in the design process, not as a novelty.
* Working experience with at least one AI prototyping environment such as v0, Lovable, Bolt, Framer AI, or Figma Make.
* Strong systems thinking and comfort designing within and contributing to a large, evolving design system.
* Ability to design complex, information-dense enterprise workflows with clarity, balancing power-user depth with accessibility for less technical users.
* A portfolio with shipped B2B or enterprise SaaS work demonstrating decision-making, not just final visuals.
* Strong written communication skills for working asynchronously across time zones.
* Comfortable working independently and driving design direction with limited oversight.
* Cybersecurity, networking, or infrastructure product experience is a strong plus, but not required. We can teach the domain; we cannot teach taste and judgment.
* Experience with MSSP or multi-tenant admin workflows is a bonus.
* A clear point of view on how AI changes product design, and where its limits are.

title: Lead Communication Designer
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
  
  
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
  
  
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
  
  
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
  
  
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
  
  
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
  
  
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
  
  
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're hiring a Lead Communication Designer for the product marketing design pod in Razorpay's in-house creative studio. The pod designs product marketing content, GTMs, feature launches, and advertising campaigns for every Razorpay product across countries, and takes part in Razorpay brand and ad campaigns.
  
  
You'll lead a high-talent team of motion designers, art directors, editors, and AI builders — winner of Creative and Design Team at the ET Brand Disruption Awards 2026, with recent wins at Kyoorius, Effie, and the Shorty Awards — and take its work up a notch. You're an art director first, a brand builder through campaigns, and someone who builds with AI, not just uses it.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
Art direction and brand
  
  
Set creative direction for product marketing content, GTMs, feature launches, and advertising campaigns across countries — shoots, storyboards,
  
  
motion, edit, type, and colour.
  
  
Own pod-level charters end to end across products like Payment Gateway, Cross Border, POS, Engage, Cards, and RazorpayX.
  
  
Take part in Razorpay brand and ad campaigns, and lead flagship moments like FTX and IPL.
  
  
Shape briefs with PMMs: challenge weak positioning, sharpen the narrative, and pitch campaigns before anyone asks.
  
  
Turn campaign wins into brand systems — visual languages, imagery styles, motion kits — every product can use.
  
  
AI at scale
  
  
Push Midjourney, Nano Banana, Runway, Higgsfield, and Seedance past generic output to brand-quality videos, campaigns, and product identities.
  
  
Build web experiences, tools, and automations with Claude and Gemini through APIs or MCPs, including pipelines for variants, localisation, and resizes.
  
  
Decide which tools the studio adopts, document the workflows, and train the team.
  
  
**Team leadership**
Lead junior designers day to day: run sprint sheets, weekly workload planning, and reviews.
  
  
Coach them in art direction and AI; delegate BAU and build SOPs so quality scales through the team.
  
  
Raise scope, timeline, and quality risks with stakeholders early and directly.
  
  
Keep the studio fun and social — jams, show-and-tells, celebrating good work loudly — and help hire.
  
  
What great looks like in year one
  
  
01 Core design leadership for two major events.
  
  
02 One or two national or global awards for the studio.
  
  
03 Strong design direction across campaigns.
  
  
04 Multiple mini AI automation projects shipped through the year.
  
  
**Background we're looking for**
Education A design degree from NID or a similar design school.
  
  
Agency and in-house ATL or brand agency experience, plus time in an in-house brand marketing team.
  
  
Collaboration Has worked closely with PMMs, marketing managers, brand managers, and social media teams, and led
  
  
junior designers, animators, and editors.
  
  
Craft Art direction across Adobe Creative Suite and Figma, with basic motion and editing skills — and above all,
  
  
strong taste.
  
  
**Who You Are**
6–8 years in communication design, art direction, or brand design, ideally across in-house brand teams and creative or advertising agencies.
  
  
A portfolio with strong art direction: campaigns and films where you shaped the look, the story, and the tone.
  
  
Proven record of building or evolving a brand through campaign work, with results you can point to (reach, awards, adoption, business impact).
  
  
Strong across graphics, motion, video, and landing pages.
  
  
Ships production work with Midjourney, Nano Banana, Runway, Higgsfield, and Seedance, and has built automations with Claude or Gemini through APIs or MCPs.
  
  
Has led a team of 3–5 designers, animators, or video editors day to day — sprint sheets, weekly workload, reviews — and can show how they grew under you.
  
  
Confident with senior stakeholders: you can push back on a weak brief, pitch an idea to leadership, and win the room.
  
  
Warm, social, and fun to work with — people want to be on your team.
  
  
**Bonus points**
Live-action or 3D product direction B2B, fintech, or SaaS brand experience Games, interactive, or experiential work
  
  
You share your AI work publicly

title: Manager – SFMC Operational Execution & Email Design
description:
**About Emeritus & Daskalos**

Daskalos, a strategic initiative of Emeritus, pioneers transnational education in India by helping leading global universities establish joint campuses under the evolving Indian regulatory framework. With over 15 institutions in advanced discussions, Daskalos is shaping the next chapter in global higher education.

**Job Description**

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end operational execution of marketing communications within Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) — including campaign builds, journey orchestration, segmentation, and deployment across email and WhatsApp channels.
* Build, QA, and deploy high-quality, responsive email templates and landing page modules using HTML/CSS with a strong UI/UX sensibility, ensuring pixel-perfect rendering across devices, email clients, and dark mode.
* Design and implement multi-step journeys in Journey Builder, leveraging behavioural triggers, audience splits, and engagement data to deliver contextually relevant communications at scale.
* Manage audience segmentation and data extensions in SFMC using SQL and AMPscript to drive personalisation and dynamic content delivery.
* Collaborate with CRM strategy, content, and design teams to translate briefs into high-performing email experiences, balancing creative quality with technical execution.
* Own deliverability health: monitor sender reputation, maintain list hygiene, manage suppression lists, and implement best practices to maximise inbox placement rates.
* Set up A/B and multivariate tests on subject lines, content, CTAs, and send times; analyse results and institutionalise learnings into a testing playbook.
* Develop and maintain SFMC reporting at campaign-level and journey-level performance metrics including open rates, CTR, conversion, and revenue attribution.
* Work cross-functionally with the CRM, analytics, product, and tech teams to ensure seamless data flows, integration integrity, and platform health.
* Maintain SFMC platform hygiene: manage data extension architecture, automations, and user access; proactively identify and resolve operational bottlenecks.
* Manage WhatsApp as a performance channel within the CRM stack — building and executing WhatsApp campaigns and conversational journeys and optimising for engagement and conversion alongside email.

**Key Skills & Qualifications**

* 4–8 years of hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud - proficiency across Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, and Audience Builder is essential.
* Strong HTML and CSS skills with a proven ability to build responsive, visually polished email templates from scratch; familiarity with MJML or similar frameworks is a plus.
* Demonstrable UI/UX sensibility — understanding of email design principles, accessibility standards, typography, and visual hierarchy; able to contribute meaningfully to design decisions, not just execute them.
* Working knowledge of AMPscript for dynamic content personalisation and SQL for segmentation queries within SFMC data extensions.
* Experience with email deliverability tooling and best practices (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, inbox testing tools, list hygiene protocols).
* Proficiency in A/B testing methodology and translating test results into optimisation decisions.
* Analytical and data-driven — comfortable interpreting campaign data, building dashboards, and presenting actionable insights to marketing and leadership teams.
* Experience in B2C environments with large-scale marketing databases; Ed-tech or education sector background is an advantage.
* SFMC Email Specialist or Consultant certification is strongly preferred.
* Experience running WhatsApp as a CRM or performance channel — including campaign execution, journey design, and optimisation; familiarity with WhatsApp Business API and integration platforms is a strong advantage.
* Strong project management skills — able to manage multiple campaign builds simultaneously with rigour and accuracy.

description:
**Company Description**
Namma Veedu Vasanta Bhavan (VB World) is a hospitality company headquartered on Arcot Road in Vadapalani, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. The company is known for offering South Indian vegetarian cuisine in a family-friendly dining environment. With multiple outlets and a strong local presence, it focuses on consistent quality, customer satisfaction, and traditional flavors. Team members work in a fast-paced, service-oriented setting with opportunities to contribute to the brand’s visual identity and customer experience.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Graphic Designer role based in Chennai. The Graphic Designer will create visual assets for menus, in-store branding, promotional campaigns, social media, and other marketing materials. Daily tasks include developing design concepts, preparing layouts, selecting typography, and ensuring brand consistency across print and digital channels. The role involves collaborating closely with marketing, operations, and management teams to translate business goals into clear, appealing designs. The Graphic Designer will also refine existing materials, manage design files, and support timely delivery of creative content for ongoing promotions and events.
  
**Graphic Designer
  
  
Department: Brand & Marketing
  
Industry: Food & Beverage / Hospitality
  
Location: Chennai
  
Experience: 2–5 Years
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
Reports To: Senior Brand Marketing Manager / Brand Head
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our Brand & Marketing team. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of visual communication, branding, social media, digital marketing, and the F&B industry.
  
  
The candidate should be comfortable using AI-powered creative tools to improve speed, ideation, content quality and production efficiency while maintaining strong design fundamentals and brand consistency.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Creative & Design
  
  
- Create high-quality designs for social media, digital campaigns, advertisements, menus, posters, standees, brochures and marketing collaterals.
  
- Develop creative concepts for restaurant launches, campaigns, festivals, offers and new product launches.
  
- Design engaging Instagram posts, Reels covers, Stories, thumbnails and other digital assets.
  
- Create visual concepts that communicate the brand's personality and positioning.
  
- Maintain consistency across all brand touchpoints.
  
  
AI-Powered Design & Content
  
  
- Use AI tools for creative ideation, image generation, concept development, background generation, image enhancement and visual experimentation.
  
- Use tools such as Adobe Firefly, Photoshop AI/Generative Fill, Midjourney, DALL·E, Canva AI, ChatGPT and other emerging AI creative platforms.
  
- Develop effective prompts to generate visual concepts and creative directions.
  
- Use AI to accelerate repetitive design and production tasks while maintaining professional design quality.
  
- Explore new AI tools and workflows that can improve the Brand & Marketing team's creative output.
  
- Combine AI-generated assets with professional design and art direction rather than relying solely on generated content.
  
- Ensure AI-generated visuals remain aligned with brand guidelines and are commercially appropriate.
  
  
F&B & Marketing Creatives
  
  
- Create food-focused visual communication that makes products and dishes visually appealing.
  
- Work closely with the marketing, operations and culinary teams to understand campaigns and product launches.
  
- Develop creative assets for new outlet launches and local marketing campaigns.
  
- Support seasonal campaigns such as Diwali, Christmas, Pongal, Ramadan, Valentine's Day and New Year.
  
- Create promotional material for offers, events, collaborations and influencer campaigns.
  
  
Brand Development
  
  
- Follow established brand guidelines including typography, colours, imagery and visual language.
  
- Contribute ideas for evolving the brand's visual identity.
  
- Develop campaign mood boards, references and visual directions.
  
- Assist in photoshoot art direction and creative styling when required.
  
  
Required Skills
  
  
- Strong knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.
  
- Good knowledge of InDesign, Canva and/or Figma.
  
- Strong understanding of typography, layout, colour theory and composition.
  
- Excellent visual sense and attention to detail.
  
- Understanding of social media design and digital marketing.
  
- Ability to create multiple creative variations within tight deadlines.
  
- Strong understanding of AI-powered creative tools.
  
- Good communication and teamwork skills.
  
- Ability to work in a fast-paced F&B environment.
  
  
Preferred Skills
  
  
- Basic knowledge of motion graphics / After Effects.
  
- Basic video editing skills using Premiere Pro, CapCut or similar tools.
  
- Experience creating creatives for Instagram and other social platforms.
  
- Photography and food styling knowledge is an advantage.
  
- Experience in hospitality, restaurants, food brands, retail or consumer brands is preferred.
  
  
AI Expectations
  
  
The candidate should be a designer who knows how to use AI, not someone who depends on AI to design.
  
  
We expect the designer to:
  
  
- Experiment with new AI creative tools.
  
- Build efficient AI-assisted design workflows.
  
- Use AI for ideation, mood boards and concept exploration.
  
- Generate and refine visual assets using AI.
  
- Use AI-assisted photo editing and enhancement.
  
- Create multiple creative directions quickly.
  
- Maintain human creative judgment, brand consistency and quality control.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators
  
  
- Quality and consistency of creative output.
  
- Speed and efficiency of campaign execution.
  
- Ability to develop fresh and innovative visual concepts.
  
- Social-media creative performance.
  
- Effective adoption of AI tools and workflows.
  
- Timely delivery of marketing requirements.
  
- Consistency with brand guidelines.
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  
We are looking for someone who is:
  
  
Creative • Curious • Fast • Detail-Oriented • AI-Savvy • Brand-Conscious • Trend-Aware
  
  
A strong portfolio demonstrating branding, social media, F&B/consumer campaigns and AI-assisted creative work will be highly preferred.This version is designed to be suitable for VB World / a multi-brand F&B marketing team. I can also make a more senior “Senior Graphic Designer / AI Creative Designer” JD with stronger responsibility for brand campaigns, AI workflows and team leadership.**

title: AI Product Builder
description:
Location: Andheri, Mumbai

**About BOMBAYDC**

BOMBAYDC is a strategic digital platform firm helping enterprises build intelligent digital platforms that increase adoption, retention and revenue.

We work at the intersection of strategy, product, design, technology and AI to turn complex business problems into products people actually use.

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for an AI Product Builder who can take a product from client requirement to working prototype.

This is not a traditional Product Manager, Designer or Developer role. You’ll operate across all three — understanding the problem, defining the product, designing the experience and using AI-native tools to rapidly build and prototype the solution.

You should be comfortable taking an idea from “Here’s the problem” → “Here’s what we should build” → “Here’s the working prototype.”

**What You'll Do**

• Understand client requirements, business goals and user problems

• Translate ambiguous requirements into clear product concepts and user flows

• Define product scope, features and MVPs

• Design intuitive UX/UI and product experiences

• Use AI and no/low-code tools to rapidly build functional prototypes

• Work with engineers and designers to take concepts further

• Manage the project end-to-end — from discovery to prototype delivery

• Present ideas and prototypes to clients and incorporate feedback quickly

• Make smart trade-offs between user experience, business requirements and technical feasibility

• Use AI tools extensively across research, ideation, design, development and documentation

**You'll Probably Enjoy This Role If You Have**

• Strong product thinking with good UX/UI fundamentals

• Experience taking products from problem definition to prototype

• A builder mindset — you like making things, not just documenting them

• Comfort working directly with clients and senior stakeholders

• Ability to independently manage projects and coordinate designers and developers

• Strong understanding of modern AI tools and AI-native product development

• Ability to quickly learn new tools and technologies

• Strong communication, ownership and execution skills

• Curiosity about how AI is changing the way products are built

Experience across B2B SaaS, Banking, FinTech, Enterprise Platforms, Commerce or AI products is valuable.

**Success In This Role**

Within 3–6 months, you should be able to independently take a client problem, define the right product direction and deliver a high-quality working prototype.

Over time, we expect you to become someone who can own entire product initiatives — from client conversation to shipped experience.

**What You'll Get**

• Opportunity to work on complex enterprise products

• Direct exposure to clients, founders and senior leadership

• Freedom to experiment with AI-native tools and workflows

• Ownership from problem definition to product delivery

• One remote working day every week

• Extended year-end winter break of 7 days

• Clear growth opportunities as the company scales

**Our Culture**

We're a fairly ambitious company and we care deeply about the quality of our work.

We don't believe in working long hours for the sake of it, but we do believe in ownership and doing what's required to deliver great outcomes.

People here get a lot of responsibility very early. We value curiosity, independent thinking, attention to detail and a desire to continuously improve.

We're not a highly process-heavy or layered organization.

We expect people to ask good questions, challenge assumptions and keep raising the bar for themselves and the team.

We welcome people who are excited about building for the new world with AI. We move very fast. You should too.

If you enjoy moving between product, design, technology, AI and client conversations — and want to build real products rather than just manage them — you'll probably enjoy this role.

Apply through LinkedIn or drop an email to work@bombaydc.com with your resume and portfolio.
